name: integer_comparison
description: Evaluate integer inequality as Python True or False; matched control copies the first operand in the same few-shot template.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 a=random.randrange(-30,31);b=random.randrange(-30,31);op=random.choice(['<','>'])
 ans=(a<b) if op=='<' else (a>b)
 pre='Python comparisons: 2 < 3 = True; 3 < 2 = False; 4 > 1 = True; 1 > 4 = False; '
 items.append({'prompt':pre+f'{a} {op} {b} =','answer':' '+str(ans)})
 control.append({'prompt':pre+f'First operand of {a} {op} {b} =','answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
